exportDialog.contrast.title: Low contrast between code and background
exportDialog.contrast.detail: Contrast is {{ratio}}:1. Phone cameras need at least 4.5:1 for reliable decoding.
exportDialog.contrast.fix: Darken the dots or lighten the background until contrast reaches at least 4.5:1.
exportDialog.inverted.title: Inverted code with limited contrast
exportDialog.inverted.detail: Light dots on a dark background at this contrast may confuse older scanners.
exportDialog.inverted.fix: Swap the colors so the dots are darker than the background.
exportDialog.quiet-zone.title: Quiet zone around finder patterns is too small
exportDialog.quiet-zone.detail: Scanners need 4 clear modules around the code to recognize the three corner squares.
exportDialog.quiet-zone.fix: Increase the margin to at least 4 blank modules on every side.
exportDialog.logo.title: Logo covers too much of the code
exportDialog.logo.detail: Error correction recovers about 30%, but not in the corner squares.
exportDialog.logo.fix: Reduce the logo to at most 25% of the code.
exportDialog.density.title: Very dense matrix
exportDialog.density.detail: This QR code contains {{length}} characters; individual modules become very small.
exportDialog.density.fix: Shorten the content or use a dynamic short link.
exportDialog.print-size.title: Print size is too small for this amount of data
exportDialog.print-size.detail: This code density requires at least {{mm}} mm to remain readable.
exportDialog.print-size.fix: Increase print size to at least {{mm}} mm.
